examples.label: Shellshock reverse-shell payload in the User-Agent header
Catch the shell on a listener

notes: The payload goes in a header (User-Agent/Cookie) that the CGI script exports into the environment - () { :; }; is the Bash function trick. Any reachable .cgi/.sh under cgi-bin is a candidate.

recommended.note: The other classic CGI attack (Windows .bat injection).

name: Shellshock - CGI RCE (CVE-2014-6271)
description: Bash Shellshock: CGI scripts export request headers into environment variables, so a crafted User-Agent with a function-definition prefix executes trailing commands. Swap the command for a reverse shell.

defense.why_it_works: Shellshock (CVE-2014-6271) exploits bash's environment variable handling. HTTP headers (User-Agent, Cookie) containing a bash function definition followed by commands are passed to CGI scripts, causing bash to execute the appended commands during initialization.
defense.prerequisites: Web server running CGI scripts executed by unpatched bash (< 4.3.25). CGI path (/cgi-bin/) publicly accessible. No WAF filtering malicious header patterns.
defense.impact: Unauthenticated RCE as www-data. Webshell deployment, reverse shell, and full host compromise from a single crafted HTTP request.
defense.detection: HTTP requests with '() { :; };' pattern in User-Agent/Cookie/Referer headers. IDS Shellshock signatures (Snort SID 2018486+). WAF alert for bash function body pattern.
defense.artifacts: Web server access log (Shellshock payload in User-Agent) | IDS/WAF alert (Shellshock signature) | Process log: bash spawned from apache with unexpected commands
defense.prevention: Update bash to 4.3.25+. Replace CGI bash scripts with non-bash alternatives (Python, Perl). Remove CGI if not required. Deploy WAF with Shellshock signatures.
defense.misconfiguration: Web server runs CGI scripts executed by unpatched bash. /cgi-bin/ publicly accessible. HTTP headers passed as environment variables to CGI scripts (standard CGI behavior).
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Unpatched bash: GNU bash, version 4.3.0(1)
# Apache httpd.conf -- CGI enabled
ScriptAlias /cgi-bin/ "/var/www/cgi-bin/"
<Directory "/var/www/cgi-bin">
  Options +ExecCGI
  AddHandler cgi-script .cgi .sh
</Directory>
defense.secure_config:
# Update bash
apt-get install --only-upgrade bash
bash --version  # confirm >= 4.3.25
# Remove CGI if not needed
a2dismod cgi
# ModSecurity Shellshock rule
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS "\(\s*\)\s*\{" "deny,status:400"
defense.evasion: Use Cookie, Referer, or custom headers if User-Agent is filtered. Slight variations: '() { ignored; }; command'.
